Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the explicit nationality information presented in the Wikipedia JSON-LD metadata during Step 10. The metadata clearly stated `"nationality": "English"`, yet the agent's analysis in Step 11 (and subsequent steps) incorrectly concluded that the nationality was "American" based on the article's text description ("American documentary film") and search snippets, while simultaneously noting a contradiction with the JSON-LD data. This led to a failure to extract the correct, explicit data point available in the source, resulting in the propagation of an incorrect nationality (American) instead of the one explicitly coded in the source (English). The agent prioritized the narrative text over the structured data field which explicitly defines the nationality attribute.
